_about: Cameras on the real YAM rig (duchamp3), measured 2026-10-25. Null = not measured yet. Sim counterpart: Menagerie yam_linear_4310.xml 'wrist_cam' (RealSense D405, 1.93 mm focal, 3.896 x 2.140 mm sensor, ~90 x 58 deg FOV, RGB + depth) rendered at EnvCfg.cam_res (64) square. The real wrist cameras differ: RGB only (no depth), 5:4 sensor, intrinsics and mount pose unknown until calibrated. Device paths are in scripts/real/rig.py.

wrist.model: generic UVC webcam (Generic 'USB Camera', iSerial 'YHTek'; Realtek chip, USB 0bda:5883)
wrist._serial_note: both cameras report the same iSerial 'YHTek', so they are told apart by USB port only
wrist._calib_note: intrinsics at 1280x1024: {fx, fy, cx, cy} in pixels; distortion: OpenCV coefficients [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3]

sim._about: Read by EnvCfg.cam_spec (blind_insertion/assets/real_camera.py). The policy image on both sides: undistort, crop the largest square centred on the principal point (1024x1024 at 1280x1024), resize to cam_res. Null = not measured: the env keeps the model's D405 value and prints a placeholder warning.
sim._fovy_note: = 2 atan(512 / fy) with fy at 1280x1024, from the intrinsic calibration. The model's D405 placeholder is 58.0 deg (its 16:9 sensor, vertical).
sim._pose_note: camera optical frame (OpenCV: +z along the optical axis, +y down) in the YAM link_6 frame, from the hand-eye calibration; {pos: [m], quat: [w, x, y, z]}. The model's D405 placeholder: pos [0.0, 0.070435, 0.077006], quat [0.0, 0.0, -0.21644, 0.976296].

top.usb: USB 3 (5 Gbps) required for the SDK
top._intrinsics_note: factory calibration from the ZED SDK 5.2, rectified images (distortion removed); left and right identical
